account: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University in Ethiopia and its partner O-SKILLS PLC plan a nine-month pilot of a virtual electronics laboratory. In an International Telecommunication Union report of June 2025, the team describes AI feedback and support in Amharic. The account states that students of the university would build the AI instructor and that O-SKILLS would build the 3D lab. It reports no gains in access or skills. On 29 October 2026 the O-SKILLS Visual Hub page offered a waitlist for its 3D simulated labs. The page does not mention the AI instructor or a pilot result.
